title: Admission reason does not drift on a same-day re-save: a day-3 complication never becomes the admitted-with reason, and the re-saved value replaces the earlier one

seed.name: QA Hosp NoDx {tag}
seed.note: the former spec.variants 'no-header-diagnosis': created with no diagnosis

goal: For {hospitalPatient}: open the pre-round notes editor, type this text: "Pre-round review for today, written from the morning list before rounds. 72-year-old woman with COPD and CKD stage 3 admitted with community-acquired pneumonia. On ceftriaxone and azithromycin, breathing easier. Potassium 5.6 this morning." Press Save Note and wait until the editor closes and the panels update. Open the editor again, select all the text in the pre-round box and replace it with: "Pre-round review for today, written from the morning list before rounds. Hospital day 3. New fever to 39.1 overnight with watery diarrhea, C. diff toxin sent and positive. Started oral vancomycin 125 mg four times daily. Pneumonia improving, off oxygen. Potassium 4.6." Press Save Note and wait until the panels update. Save checkpoint 1 on the Pre-Round tab with the patient header, the Hospital Course section and the Labs panel visible. Open the Encounter tab, wait until its Tasks list stops changing (up to 30 seconds) and save checkpoint 2. Open the Post-Round tab, open its Medication Tracker and save checkpoint 3. Then go back to the Hospital list, open the chart of {hospitalPatient2} and do the same two Save Notes on its Pre-Round tab with the same two texts: first "Pre-round review for today, written from the morning list before rounds. 72-year-old woman with COPD and CKD stage 3 admitted with community-acquired pneumonia. On ceftriaxone and azithromycin, breathing easier. Potassium 5.6 this morning.", Save Note and wait until the panels update; then select all the text in the pre-round box, replace it with "Pre-round review for today, written from the morning list before rounds. Hospital day 3. New fever to 39.1 overnight with watery diarrhea, C. diff toxin sent and positive. Started oral vancomycin 125 mg four times daily. Pneumonia improving, off oxygen. Potassium 4.6.", Save Note and wait until the panels update. Save checkpoint 4 on its Pre-Round tab with the patient header, the Hospital Course section and the Labs panel visible.
